Cell type and cell state are assigned on separate axes.

The clustering is fixed a priori and contributes a measured ceiling of 0.636 on per-cell accuracy, so no absolute number from this run is comparable to a published figure and only the comparison between systems on identical cells is in scope.
Ground truth is expert-reviewed CL-mapped AIDA author annotation, not orthogonal protein-measured or FACS-sorted labels, so this run measures agreement with those labels and not cell-type accuracy.
Automated predictions are hypotheses and disagreement remains visible.

The marker vocabulary in pbmc_markers.json is a pre-declaration written from standard human PBMC immunology before any AIDA cluster was inspected, and its self-authored provenance is a declared limitation rather than a property this run can establish.
Panel-absent features are unmeasured rather than negative evidence.
Unknown is a permitted successful outcome.
